bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/keychain.rs (generic secrets only), springboard/src/bare/account.rs (local OS account), springboard/src/shell/login.rs (sign-in), bifrost-cloud account API (separate repo)
summary: Apple's Accounts framework is deprecated (landing page: for new apps, use the service provider's SDK). BifrOSt has no system account store, no account types, no OAuth credential objects and no access-grant prompt for third-party accounts. The closest pieces are a per-app keychain for opaque secrets and the local OS account used for desktop sign-in.

features.apple: ACAccountStore: accounts, account(withIdentifier:), accounts(with:), saveAccount, removeAccount, requestAccessToAccounts
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 26 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3) made the pure model; sprint1/3-accounts makes it persistent: AccountStore::open(shared_path()) keeps accounts.ini in the user's data directory, written atomically through bifrost_core::fsutil::write_atomic; every change runs against the file's current contents, reload() picks up another handle's changes, and observe_did_change fires for each change (ACAccountStoreDidChange). Credentials are not written to the file. Not yet wired into the apps or the shell, and not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Built 2026-10-17: the accounts.ini reader and writer moved to bifrost_ui::account_store (one format for the SDK and the shell); Settings > Internet Accounts lists the saved accounts under their types, read only; tests the_next_identifier_is_above_the_highest_saved_one, encode_then_decode_round_trips_every_field (springboard/ui/src/account_store.rs) and accounts_apps_saved_are_listed_under_their_type (springboard/src/shell/internet_accounts_page.rs).

features.apple: ACAccount: identifier, username, userFullName, accountDescription, accountType, credential
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 26 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The OS knows the local user name, uid, gid and home. No app-facing SDK API exposes it, and it is not a registry of third-party accounts.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/keychain.rs (add, get, update, delete of opaque bytes by service and account); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01d.rs
features.note: An app stores a token itself as an opaque keychain secret, and a_keychain_add_is_sent_with_its_service_account_and_secret checks the add message headless. The typed credential is kept in memory by the account store and not written to accounts.ini; after a reopen the app sets it again from its keychain item. There is no refresh-token flow beyond renewCredentials, and no shared store between apps for secrets. Built 2026-10-17: the credential is saved in the keychain under service bifrost.accounts, account credential:<identifier>, with save_credential (update), save_credential_add (when the item is missing), read_credential and credential_from_reply (a non-success reply is CredentialNotFound); tests a_keychain_reply_carries_the_credential_back and credential_items_are_named_per_account (springboard/sdk/src/accounts.rs). The file still holds no secret.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 26 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests. The access grant (accessGranted) persists in accounts.ini, so a grant survives a restart. There is still no user prompt that grants access to a type of account, and the manifest permission binds only keychain access. Not yet wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Built 2026-10-17: AccountStore::register_builtin_types adds the system types (BUILTIN_TYPES: bifrost.mail, bifrost.caldav, bifrost.carddav, bifrost.cloud) that are not held yet, ungranted, and keeps existing grants; tests builtin_types_are_registered_once_and_keep_their_grant and builtin_types_survive_a_reopen (springboard/sdk/src/accounts.rs). Built 2026-10-17: Internet Accounts kinds name their store type (bifrost_ui::internet_accounts::Kind::account_type); tests every_kind_has_its_own_account_type_name (springboard/ui/src/internet_accounts.rs) and every_internet_accounts_kind_is_a_builtin_type (springboard/sdk/src/accounts.rs). The Internet Accounts page still lists only its own list: the shell crate cannot depend on bifrost-app, so the page cannot read accounts.ini yet. Built 2026-10-17: requestAccessToAccounts is answered by the access sheet: the accounts service (request_access) queues an Allow / Don't Allow card (springboard/src/shell/account_access_sheet.rs), and Allow writes accessGranted to accounts.ini through bifrost_ui::account_store::set_access. The SDK asks with accounts::request_access and reads the answer with access_answer. Tests: a_request_waits_for_the_sheet_and_its_answer_is_taken_once and the_queue_refuses_past_its_limit (springboard/src/shell/services/accounts_access.rs), an_access_answer_is_written_for_a_known_type_only (springboard/ui/src/account_store.rs), an_access_reply_is_pending_granted_refused_or_invalid (springboard/sdk/src/accounts.rs). Open: a refusal is not remembered, so the card returns for each new request; any app may ask (no manifest permission yet). Built 2026-10-17: a refused request is remembered per app and type in accounts.ini ([refusal] sections, kept by the SDK on every write); an app is asked again only after the person clears its row under Declined Requests in Settings > Internet Accounts; tests a_refusal_is_kept_until_it_is_removed (springboard/ui/src/account_store.rs), the_gate_grants_refuses_and_asks_from_the_store_alone (springboard/src/shell/services/accounts_access.rs), a_refused_request_is_listed_and_clearing_it_is_an_action (springboard/src/shell/internet_accounts_page.rs). Built 2026-10-17: request_access needs the manifest permission accounts (permissions = ["accounts"]); without it the answer is permission_denied and no sheet is shown (permission_denial in springboard/src/shell/services/accounts_access.rs, test a_request_needs_the_accounts_permission_in_the_manifest; SDK access_answer reads a denial as a refusal).

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 26 tests. Wave 5 (theme-06, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No token refresh path. Apps refresh tokens themselves through springboard/sdk/src/url.rs (URLSession) if needed. Built 2026-10-17: token expiry check: Credential::needs_renewal(now, margin) (OAuth 2 only) and AccountStore::renewal_due(identifier, now, margin), so an app renews before a request fails; tests an_oauth2_credential_needs_renewal_inside_the_margin and renewal_due_checks_the_saved_credential (springboard/sdk/src/accounts.rs).

features.apple: Account sign-in sheets and the 'create account in app' flow of requestAccessToAccounts
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/login.rs (desktop sign-in: password field, authentication through privd, lockout); springboard/sdk/src/sign_in.rs (callback scheme, one-time code lookup)
features.note: The app-facing sign-in helpers (callback scheme and one-time code lookup) are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-os-10.rs. Gap: no sheet lets an app create an account or add a third-party one.

features.feature: Secure secret storage used for credentials
features.apple: Keychain items as the backing store of account credentials (Accounts keeps them in its database)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 16 tests. Per-app, encrypted with a master key on the same disk. No access groups, so apps cannot share credentials, and no user-presence protection.

features.apple: Not part of Accounts; Apple's equivalent is Apple Account sign-in
features.note: The sign-in and sign-out requests, the answer reader and the error mapping of the cloud HTTP API are tested headless with canned answers. Gap: the transport runs only on the URL session, which needs the lab machine and a live cloud server; signup, profile, devices and the session store are not exposed.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 26 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No Accounts error domain. Keychain errors are mirrored from Apple's Security codes, not from Accounts.

gaps: No account list the apps share yet: the file-backed store (accounts.ini) exists, but no app reads it, and the Settings Internet Accounts pane keeps its own list in internet-accounts.ini, so Mail, Calendar and Contacts still see separate lists.
No account type registry and no access-grant prompt (requestAccessToAccounts, accessGranted).
No typed OAuth credential objects, token expiry or credential renewal.
No SDK API for the local OS account (bare/account.rs) or for the BifrOSt cloud account.
The framework itself is deprecated by Apple; new apps should use the service provider's SDK, so parity here is low priority.
